objetivos: Relatar perguntas com a ordem correta das palavras

exercicios.regra: Nas perguntas relatadas, a ordem volta a ser afirmativa (sujeito antes do verbo) e não se usa o auxiliar do/does/did. Perguntas yes/no usam 'if/whether'; perguntas wh- mantêm a wh-word.
exemplos: "Are you coming?" she asked. → She asked if I was coming.
"Where do you live?" he asked. → He asked where I lived.
"What time is it?" → She asked what time it was.

erroComum.errado: She asked if was I coming.
erroComum.correto: She asked if I was coming.
erroComum.descricaoPT: Nas perguntas relatadas, a ordem das palavras volta a ser afirmativa (sujeito antes do verbo) — não se mantém a inversão da pergunta original.

exercicios.pergunta: "Are you coming?" she asked. → She asked if ___.
"Where do you live?" he asked. → He asked where ___.

exercicios.frase: "What time is it?" → She asked what time ___.

exercicios.origem: Ele perguntou se eu estava cansado.
exercicios.destino: He asked if I was tired.

srsItens.pergunta: Qual a ordem das palavras numa pergunta relatada?
srsItens.resposta: ordem afirmativa (sujeito antes do verbo), sem auxiliar do/does/did

objetivos: Relatar ordens e pedidos com 'to' + infinitivo

exercicios.regra: Ordens e pedidos relatados usam 'told/asked' + pessoa + to + infinitivo (afirmativa) ou not to + infinitivo (negativa).
exemplos: "Close the door," he said. → He told me to close the door.
"Please help me," she said. → She asked me to help her.
"Don't be late," they said. → They told us not to be late.

erroComum.errado: He told me that close the door.
erroComum.correto: He told me to close the door.
erroComum.descricaoPT: Ordens relatadas usam 'to' + infinitivo, não 'that' + oração completa — estrutura diferente do discurso relatado de afirmações.

exercicios.pergunta: "Close the door," he said. → He told me ___ the door.
"Don't be late," they said. → They told us ___ late.

exercicios.frase: "Please help me," she said. → She asked me ___ help her.

exercicios.origem: Ela pediu-me para fechar a janela.
exercicios.destino: She asked me to close the window.

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: He told me to close the door.
respostaEsperada: He told me to close the door.

objetivos: Usar although, despite/in spite of e however corretamente

exercicios.regra: Although/though introduzem uma oração completa; despite/in spite of são seguidos de nome ou gerúndio (não de oração completa); however liga duas frases separadas.
exemplos: Although it was raining, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out. / Despite raining, we went out.
It was raining. However, we went out.

erroComum.errado: Despite it was raining, we went out.
erroComum.correto: Despite the rain, we went out. / Although it was raining, we went out.
erroComum.descricaoPT: 'Despite' e 'in spite of' nunca são seguidos de uma oração completa (sujeito+verbo) — só de nome ou gerúndio.

exercicios.pergunta: ___ it was raining, we went out.

exercicios.frase: It was raining. ___, we went out.

exercicios.origem: Apesar do frio, ela saiu sem casaco.
exercicios.destino: Despite the cold, she went out without a coat.

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: Although it was raining, we went out.
respostaEsperada: Although it was raining, we went out.

exercicios.regra: Because/since/as introduzem a causa; therefore/so introduzem o efeito/consequência.
exemplos: I stayed home because I was ill.
Since it was late, we decided to leave.
It was raining, therefore we stayed home.

erroComum.errado: I was ill, because I stayed home.
erroComum.correto: I stayed home because I was ill.
erroComum.descricaoPT: 'Because' introduz a causa, não o efeito — a ordem lógica da frase importa para o sentido ficar correto.

exercicios.pergunta: I stayed home ___ I was ill.
It was raining, ___ we stayed home.

exercicios.frase: ___ it was late, we decided to leave.

exercicios.origem: Estava a chover, por isso ficámos em casa.
exercicios.destino: It was raining, so we stayed home.

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: I stayed home because I was ill.
respostaEsperada: I stayed home because I was ill.

objetivos: Usar moreover, furthermore e in addition, e saber quando são apropriados

exercicios.regra: Moreover, furthermore e in addition acrescentam informação, normalmente em registo mais formal/escrito.
exemplos: The hotel is cheap. Moreover, it's very central.
She is talented; furthermore, she works very hard.
In addition to English, she speaks French.

erroComum.errado: Usar 'moreover'/'furthermore' em conversa informal do dia a dia.
erroComum.correto: Estes conectores são mais próprios de escrita formal — em conversa informal usa-se mais 'also'.
erroComum.descricaoPT: O registo importa: usar conectores muito formais numa conversa casual pode soar estranho ou pomposo.

exercicios.pergunta: The hotel is cheap. ___, it's very central.
Which connector is most natural in informal conversation?

exercicios.origem: Ela é talentosa; além disso, trabalha muito.
exercicios.destino: She is talented; furthermore, she works very hard.

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: The hotel is cheap. Moreover, it's very central.
respostaEsperada: The hotel is cheap. Moreover, it's very central.

srsItens.pergunta: 'Moreover' e 'furthermore' são mais próprios de que registo?

objetivos: Formar a voz passiva no Present Continuous e Present Perfect

exercicios.regra: A voz passiva também se forma no Present Continuous (is being + particípio) e no Present Perfect (has been + particípio).
exemplos: The house is being built.
The report has been finished.
The car is being repaired right now.

erroComum.correto: The house is being built now.
erroComum.descricaoPT: Present Continuous passivo precisa de 'being' antes do particípio — sem ele, a frase fica incompleta.

exercicios.explicacao: Present Continuous passivo: is being built.
Present Perfect passivo: has been finished.

exercicios.origem: A casa está a ser construída.

srsItens.pergunta: Como se forma a voz passiva no Present Continuous?

titulo: Verbos com Duas Preposições / Objeto Indireto
objetivos: Usar corretamente verbos com objeto indireto e direto

exercicios.regra: Alguns verbos podem ter dois objetos (indireto + direto) sem preposição, ou com 'to'/'for'. Outros verbos (como 'explain') precisam sempre de 'to' antes da pessoa.
exemplos: I gave her a book. / I gave a book to her.
She made me a cake. / She made a cake for me.
He explained the problem to me. (não 'explained me')

erroComum.correto: He explained the problem to me.
erroComum.descricaoPT: 'Explain' não aceita objeto indireto diretamente — precisa sempre de 'to' antes da pessoa, ao contrário de 'give' ou 'tell'.

opcoes: He explained the problem to me.
I gave to her a book.

exercicios.destino: He explained the problem to me.

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: I gave her a book for her birthday.
respostaEsperada: I gave her a book for her birthday.

srsItens.pergunta: Que preposição precisa 'explain' antes da pessoa?

objetivos: Fazer pedidos indiretos e educados: Would you mind...? Could you possibly...?

exercicios.regra: Pedidos indiretos soam mais educados/formais: Would you mind...? Could you possibly...? Do you think you could...?
exemplos: Would you mind closing the window?
Could you possibly help me with this?
Do you think you could send me the file?

erroComum.errado: Would you mind to close the window?
erroComum.correto: Would you mind closing the window?
erroComum.descricaoPT: 'Would you mind' é seguido de gerúndio, não de infinitivo com 'to' — exceção importante a memorizar.

exercicios.pergunta: Which is the most formal/indirect request?
opcoes: Would you mind closing the window?

exercicios.frase: Could you ___ help me with this?

exercicios.destino: Would you mind closing the door?

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: Would you mind closing the window?
respostaEsperada: Would you mind closing the window?

srsItens.pergunta: Que forma verbal segue 'would you mind'?

objetivos: Reconhecer falsos amigos PT-EN de nível mais avançado

exercicios.regra: Mais falsos amigos PT-EN, agora de nível mais avançado: eventually (finalmente/por fim, não 'eventualmente'), sensible (sensato, não 'sensível'), assist (ajudar, não 'assistir/ver').
exemplos: Eventually, we found the answer. (finalmente)
That was a sensible decision. (sensata)
Can you assist me with this? (ajudar)

erroComum.correto: It might rain. / Possibly, it will rain.
erroComum.descricaoPT: 'Eventually' significa 'finalmente/por fim' (depois de um processo), não 'possivelmente' — é um dos falsos amigos mais traiçoeiros do inglês.

objetivos: Combinar Present Perfect, pedidos educados e vocabulário profissional numa entrevista de emprego

exercicios.regra: Vamos juntar Present Perfect, pedidos educados e vocabulário profissional numa simulação de entrevista de emprego.
exemplos: I have worked in marketing for five years.
Could you tell me more about the role?
I believe my experience makes me a strong candidate.

erroComum.errado: I have five years experience since 2019 (misturando for/since incorretamente).
erroComum.correto: I have five years of experience. / I have worked here since 2019.
erroComum.descricaoPT: Não misturar 'for' (duração) com 'since' (ponto de partida) na mesma expressão.

opcoes.texto: I have worked in marketing for five years.

nos.interlocutorFala: That's great. Could you tell me more about your last role?

opcoes.texto: Of course, I was responsible for managing a small team.

exercicios.pergunta: Which is a good way to describe experience?
opcoes: I have worked in marketing for five years.
I working marketing since five years.

exercicios.origem: Acredito que a minha experiência me torna um bom candidato.
exercicios.destino: I believe my experience makes me a strong candidate.

exercicios.instrucao: Escreve 2-3 frases a apresentares a tua experiência profissional numa entrevista, usando Present Perfect.
exercicios.respostaModelo: I have worked in customer service for three years. I have developed strong communication skills.

exercicios.textoParaOuvir: Could you tell me more about your last role?
respostaEsperada: Could you tell me more about your last role?

srsItens.pergunta: Como descrever experiência profissional numa entrevista?
srsItens.resposta: I have worked in... for [duração] / since [ano]
